title: LinkPreview
description: See what links in chat are about before clicking them, safely and automatically.
body:
![LinkPreview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7acb81f577357dd88d5ffe227f7f4a51079474eb.png) [![Email](https://img.shields.io/badge/Contact-EA4335?style=for-the-badge&logo=gmail&logoColor=white)](mailto:contact@knochenn.de) [![Support on Ko-Fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Support%20on%20Ko--fi-FF5E5B?style=for-the-badge&logo=ko-fi&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/knochennmc) [![Source](https://img.shields.io/badge/View%20Source-181717?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/DevKnochen/LinkPreview) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache%202.0-blue?style=for-the-badge) ### Why see a boring link when you could see _**this**_? ![LinkPreview in Action](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04e2fecd48647ee52569916c9997f592233d1f98.jpeg) *Titles. Thumbnails. Descriptions. Right there in your chat.*
--- ## 🔗 Paste a link, get a preview Send a link in chat and LinkPreview will automatically fetch and display a rich embed. Just like in Discord. Supported sites include: | | Site | Preview includes | |---|---|---| | 🌐 | **Most Websites** | Page title and description | | 🖼️ | **Images** | Inline preview of the image itself | | 🎬 | **YouTube** | Video title, channel name, and thumbnail | | 🎵 | **Spotify** | Track title, artist name, and thumbnail | > 🔒 **The site never sees your IP.** To fetch link previews, LinkPreview connects to an external Cloudflare server on your behalf. --- ## 📥 Getting started ### 🎮 Minecraft Client 1. Download **LinkPreview** and the [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api). 2. Drop it in your `mods/` folder. 3. Boot up Minecraft. 4. Send a link in chat. That's it! > ⚠️ Only download from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/linkpreview). Don't trust random sites! --- ## 🐛 Something broken? Open an issue on [GitHub](https://github.com/DevKnochen/LinkPreview/issues). Describe your issue, include what version you're on, what other mods you have, and any crash logs. We'll sort it out. --- ## 📩 Contact Reach out at contact@knochenn.de ---
*Enjoyed it? A ❤️ on Modrinth or a ⭐ on GitHub genuinely makes our day.*
